recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing operation-definition part of the published Jira resolution while preserving the already-applied action structure and aligning the new operation text with current PlanDefinition $apply guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-34265 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested RequestGroup action input, output, definition, dynamicValue, and transform support, plus a RequestGroup/$apply operation mirroring PlanDefinition/$apply.
initial_application: Commit d9a4d4c599 added the requested definitional and dynamic action elements to RequestOrchestration, but no RequestGroup/RequestOrchestration $apply OperationDefinition was added and the active operations list remained empty.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini build scope maps legacy RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration. Later PlanDefinition $apply work, especially FHIR-46313 and the related Zulip discussion, relaxed output guidance to allow Bundles containing any appropriate Request resources rather than requiring only a RequestOrchestration wrapper.
reconciliation: Created source/requestorchestration/operationdefinition-RequestOrchestration-apply.xml and referenced OperationDefinition/RequestOrchestration-apply from source/requestorchestration/list-RequestOrchestration-operations.xml. The operation follows current PlanDefinition $apply shape for type and instance invocation and returns one Bundle per input subject.
source_changes: source/requestorchestration/operationdefinition-RequestOrchestration-apply.xml: added a RequestOrchestration apply OperationDefinition with type/instance invocation, application context parameters, and Bundle return semantics.
source/requestorchestration/list-RequestOrchestration-operations.xml: added the OperationDefinition/RequestOrchestration-apply list entry so the operation is included with the active resource.

related_jiras.note: Earlier PlanDefinition $apply semantics explain the R5 RequestOrchestration output model that FHIR-34265 asked to mirror.
Later PlanDefinition $apply clarification relaxed output to any appropriate Request resources and guided the new operation wording.
Later RequestOrchestration.action.definition clarification confirms the definition element remains active in apply/realization semantics.
